text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: We should implement a visible A/B test for a new feature with 5% of users. This approach allows us to gather real-time data on user engagement and feedback, ensuring we make informed decisions about further rollouts. The trade-off is that it may slow down the deployment process, but the insights gained will lead to a more effective and user-friendly final product.

name: Gauge
text: Visible A/B tests expose the change to all users in the cohort, not just the 5%—blind rollouts to opt-in users still risk self-selection bias. Instead, run a true 5% split with a holdout group and measure engagement *and* retention; settle the argument by comparing conversion rates between the two groups over 14 days.
